attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: user_authentication_and_session_bootstrap
steps:
  - id: intercept_request
    op: middleware/check_session
    params:
      check: session_authenticated
      session_cookie: staff_session
      timeout_hours: 8
    output: session_status

  - id: redirect_to_login
    op: http/redirect
    params:
      condition: "{{ session_status.authenticated == false }}"
      target_url: /admin/login
      http_status: 302
    output: redirect_result

  - id: receive_login_submission
    op: http/receive_form
    params:
      method: POST
      endpoint: /admin/login
      fields:
        - username
        - password
    output: login_credentials

  - id: verify_credentials
    op: auth/verify_user
    params:
      username: "{{ login_credentials.username }}"
      password: "{{ login_credentials.password }}"
      lookup_source: staff_users_table
      hash_algorithm: bcrypt
    output: auth_result

  - id: establish_session
    op: session/create
    params:
      condition: "{{ auth_result.verified == true }}"
      user_id: "{{ auth_result.user_id }}"
      role: "{{ auth_result.role }}"
      session_cookie: staff_session
      timeout_hours: 8
      attributes:
        display_name: "{{ auth_result.display_name }}"
        permissions: "{{ auth_result.role_permissions }}"
        visible_menus: "{{ auth_result.role_menus }}"
    output: session_details

  - id: redirect_to_main_menu
    op: http/redirect
    params:
      condition: "{{ session_details.created == true }}"
      target_url: /admin/main-menu
      http_status: 302
    output: final_redirect

  - id: handle_failed_login
    op: http/render_template
    params:
      condition: "{{ auth_result.verified == false }}"
      template: admin/login
      context:
        error_message: "Invalid username or password. Please try again."
    output: login_error_page
